adoption_gate.two_per_model: At least10% median paired wall reduction and faster in at least3/4blocks versus BOTH one_per_model and serial, with exact128outputtokens all timedcalls, zeroerrors, and memory/power guards
adoption_gate.one_per_model: If two_per_model is not selected, at least10% median paired wall reduction and faster in at least3/4blocks versus serial, with identical-token/zero-error/resource guards
adoption_gate.serial: A valid benchmark with neither parallel gate satisfied
adoption_gate.invalid: Any request error, incomplete workload, token comparability failure or resource guard failure yields nonzero exit and requires controller cleanup/halt

ownership: V2 starts and owns isolated Ollama server/process group. Benchmark never starts/stops a server or changes scientific scheduling. Caller stops owned server on nonzero exit; shared11434server is never stopped.
preconditions: Primary exited with complete artifacts and matching protocol
Isolated server listening PID exactly matches persisted controller-owned receipt
Same binary, version and full model metadata as shared server
Shared study models drained and unloaded before benchmarking
More than720seconds remain before global hardstop
limitations: Synthetic fixed128-token generation only, not scientific endpoints or actual task completion throughput
All three modes use the same NUM_PARALLEL2 server, including serial mode
Benchmark selection does not guarantee the same speedup on graph/rewrite generation or detector scoring
Four paired blocks provide an operational gate, not a publication performance claim
actual_capacity_guard: After warmups and before timed blocks, require exactly two isolated-controller-owned llama-server runners. Read each runner loopback /props and require total_slots2 and per-slot n_ctx8192, plus exactly the two expected Ollama resident models. Record Ollama context_length metadata without assuming that field has per-slot rather than aggregate semantics.
